_notes: Australian domestic + international airline policies. Domestic fees in AUD. International fees in AUD (approximate conversion as of 2026-03). Review and update 2-3x per year.

QF.name: Qantas
QF.family_score_notes: Free bags on most fares, free seat selection, guaranteed family seating, free lap infants domestic.

domestic.notes: 23kg bag included on Flex, Classic, Business. NOT included on Sale/Red e-Deal fares (bag1_fee_lite). Seat selection free for all passengers. Family guaranteed to sit together. Lap infants free domestic.

VA.name: Virgin Australia
VA.family_score_notes: Free bags on Choice/Flex fares, no seat fee on Choice/Flex. Economy Lite has no inclusions.

domestic.notes: Economy Lite = no bag included (bag1_fee_lite), $15 seat fee. Economy Choice/Flex = bag + free seat. Lap infants free domestic. Stroller/car seat free as checked item.

JQ.name: Jetstar
JQ.family_score_notes: Pervasive add-on fees. $35 infant fee PER SECTOR (not per journey). No bag on Starter.

domestic.notes: IMPORTANT: Infant fee is $35 PER SECTOR, not per journey. Return trip = $70 per infant. Starter has no bag. Starter Plus has 20kg free. $8 seat fee per flight. Family seating not guaranteed on budget fares.

ZL.name: Rex Airlines
ZL.family_score_notes: Simple policies, free bag, free infant, small regional network.

domestic.notes: 23kg bag included. Additional baggage $20/5kg bundle. Lap infants free. Smaller network — mainly regional QLD/NSW/VIC/SA routes.

TL.name: Tigerair Australia
TL.family_score_notes: Ultra-budget, extensive fees, not recommended for families.

domestic.notes: Ultra-budget carrier. Check current status — Tigerair AU operations have been historically volatile.

SQ.name: Singapore Airlines
SQ.family_score_notes: Excellent family airline. Free 30kg bag, free seat selection, family seating available. Infant fee charged per sector on international routes.

international.notes: 30kg bag free on economy (except saver lite fares). Free seat selection. Strong family programme. Infant fee approx $55 AUD per sector on international routes from AU.

EK.name: Emirates
EK.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag on economy, seat selection fee applies. Good family facilities on widebody aircraft.

international.notes: 23kg bag free on standard economy fares. Seat selection charged. Infant fee approx $60 AUD per sector. Economy Saver/Lite fares have no bag inclusion.

CX.name: Cathay Pacific
CX.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag on economy, seat selection fee on standard. Family-friendly widebody fleet.

international.notes: 23kg bag free on economy standard. Seat selection charged on most fares. Infant fee approx $60 AUD per sector.

NZ.name: Air New Zealand
NZ.family_score_notes: Excellent for AU-NZ routes. Free bags on Choice/Flexi. Budget fares have no bag.

international.notes: 23kg bag on Choice/Flexi fares. Economy Seat/Value = no bag (bag1_fee_lite). Infant fee approx $35 AUD per sector AU-NZ.

QR.name: Qatar Airways
QR.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag. Seat selection fee. Long-haul hub via Doha. Good family service.

international.notes: 23kg bag free on economy (except lite). Seat selection fee applies. Infant fee approx $65 AUD per sector. Long haul via Doha adds transit time for families.

TG.name: Thai Airways
TG.family_score_notes: Free 20kg bag. Reasonable infant fee. Older fleet on some routes.

international.notes: 20kg bag free on economy. Seat selection charged. Infant fee approx $55 AUD per sector. Check operational status — Thai Airways restructuring ongoing.

NH.name: ANA All Nippon Airways
NH.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag. Free seat selection. Excellent punctuality. Strong family service on Japan routes.

international.notes: 23kg bag free. Free seat selection on ANA.co.jp. Infant fee approx $50 AUD per sector. Exceptional punctuality — top performer for Japan routes.

JL.name: Japan Airlines
JL.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag. Free seat selection. High punctuality. Good family service.

international.notes: 23kg bag free. Seat selection free on jal.com. Infant fee approx $50 AUD per sector. One of the most punctual carriers globally.

BA.name: British Airways
BA.family_score_notes: Basic fares include no bag. Seat selection fee applies. Long haul to UK adds fatigue for families.

international.notes: Economy standard includes 23kg bag. Economy Basic = no bag (bag1_fee_lite=$90). Seat selection charged. Infant fee approx $70 AUD per sector AU-UK.

MH.name: Malaysia Airlines
MH.family_score_notes: Free 20kg bag. Reasonable fees. Good for BNE-KUL routes.

international.notes: 20kg bag free on economy. Seat selection charged. Infant fee approx $50 AUD per sector. Good connectivity via KUL hub for SEA destinations.

GA.name: Garuda Indonesia
GA.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag. Reasonable infant fee. Good for Bali/Indonesia routes.

international.notes: 23kg bag free. Modest seat selection fee. Infant fee approx $45 AUD per sector. Primary carrier for Bali routes from AU.

AI.name: Air India
AI.family_score_notes: Free 23kg bag. Improving service post-Tata acquisition. Long haul to India routes.

international.notes: 23kg bag free on economy. Seat selection charged. Infant fee approx $55 AUD per sector. Tata-owned since 2022 — service quality improving.

_family_score_methodology.description: 0-100 composite score used in Family Flight Score calculation

components.bag_policy: 40 pts — 0 pts if no free bag, 40 pts if 23kg free
components.seat_policy: 25 pts — 0 pts if always charged, 25 pts if always free
components.infant_policy: 20 pts — 0 pts if charged per sector, 20 pts if free
components.family_seating: 10 pts — 10 pts if guaranteed, 0 pts if not
